pubmed.query: ("Fontan Procedure"[Mesh] OR Fontan[Title/Abstract] OR "Fontan circulation"[Title/Abstract] OR "Fontan physiology"[Title/Abstract] OR "total cavopulmonary connection"[Title/Abstract] OR TCPC[Title/Abstract])

europe_pmc.purpose: Supplement PubMed with Europe PMC records, including records such as preprints that may not yet be present in PubMed. Search broadly, then require a Fontan/TCPC term in the title or abstract before inclusion.

crossref.purpose: Supplement PubMed with publisher-deposited DOI metadata so online-first Fontan papers can sometimes be discovered before PubMed indexing. Only records whose titles explicitly contain Fontan/TCPC terminology are accepted.

science_direct.purpose: Optional future Elsevier ScienceDirect discovery source. The official ScienceDirect Search API requires an Elsevier API key and access depends on institutional entitlements.

major_journals: Journal of the American College of Cardiology
Journal of the American Heart Association
The Journal of Thoracic and Cardiovascular Surgery
